card.name: Commas in lists of chemical substances
card.fires_on: Commas after a drug or material name inside a list of chemicals, and words like 'containing' or 'contains' or the middle of 'halogenated' just before a chemical name.

modes.label: Comma in substance list
modes.description: The comma after an item in a list of drugs or coating materials, where another substance name comes next.

modes.label: Contains before ingredient
modes.description: The word containing or contains right before the named ingredient.

modes.label: Inside halogen words
modes.description: Partway through halogen-related words such as halogenated or halogen-phosphorous.
